findings.title: Claimed counts not verifiable from index
findings.message: The index lists capture/after/power-command.json and capture/before/power-command.json but gives no matching entry for captures like power-command's stdout path; more importantly the index lists capture/native/stdout but the README claims 18 logs and 9 groups, while the index contains only 8 groups with owned.json (display, os, power-settings, power for before and after, plus native), which is consistent only if native counts. The README's claim of 'all 18 logs' cannot be checked from the index alone, and no integrity manifest field enumerates the expected count.
findings.suggestion: Add an explicit expected-members count or list to the index so the 18-log and 9-group claims are machine-verifiable.
